title: HARE: Explainable Hate Speech Detection with Step-by-Step Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model classification accuracy and F1 scores on explicit and implicit hate speech benchmark datasets (Implicit Hate, HateXplain, DynaHate), alongside automated evaluation using GPT-4 to grade the quality of the model's step-by-step explanatory rationales.

Measuring the model's ability to detect offensive content and explain underlying stereotypes or implications using the Social Bias Inference Corpus (SBIC), evaluating both classification metrics and the alignment of generated rationales with human-annotated implied statements targeting specific demographic groups.
